results.name: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell against your top hip with your upper hand.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the dumbbell securely against your hip.
Hold the position for the desired duration, then lower your hips with control and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Maintain a straight line from your head to your feet without letting your hips drop.
Keep your shoulders and hips stacked without rotating forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to keep your pelvis lifted.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold without holding your breath.
results.description: Dumbbell Elbow Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Begin in a half-kneeling position with your left foot forward and your right knee on the floor. Hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside your right hip.
Rotate your torso to the left and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body.
Continue raising the dumbbell until your arms extend above your left shoulder.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell back toward your right hip, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your front foot flat on the floor and right knee directly below your hip for stability.
Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips and lower body stable.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and avoid pulling the dumbbell with your biceps.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press through your supporting palm and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Keep your supporting arm straight and maintain your shoulders and hips stacked while holding the position.
Hold for the desired duration, then repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Place your supporting hand directly below your shoulder and spread your fingers for stability.
Keep your feet stacked and avoid rotating your hips forward or backward.
Engage your obliques and glutes to prevent your hips from dropping.
Inhale and exhale steadily throughout the hold.
results.description: Dumbbell Hand Side Plank is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper
instructions: Kneel upright on both knees with your knees hip width apart and hold one dumbbell with both hands low beside one hip.
Rotate your torso and lift the dumbbell diagonally across your body until it is above the opposite shoulder, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your hips facing forward and your core engaged.
Reverse the movement and lower the dumbbell along the same diagonal path, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Rotate through your torso while keeping your hips stable and facing forward.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbows without pulling the dumbbell with your arms alone.
Avoid leaning backward as the dumbbell reaches the top position.
Exhale as you lift and rotate the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Dumbbell Kneeling Wood Chopper is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Shoulders, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a dumbbell horizontally above your head with both hands, keeping your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and slowly bend your torso to one side while keeping your hips still and your chest facing forward.
Pause briefly at a comfortable range while keeping the dumbbell steady overhead.
Contract your obliques to return to the upright position with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Maintain a neutral spine without leaning forward, leaning backward, or twisting.
Keep the dumbbell aligned above your head as your torso bends sideways.
Bend only as far as you can while maintaining balance and control.
Inhale as you bend to the side and exhale as you return upright.
results.description: Dumbbell Overhead Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Triceps, Core.

results.name: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your feet stacked. Place your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder and hold a dumbbell securely against your top hip.
Press your forearm into the floor and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your head to your feet.
Slowly lower your hips toward the floor while keeping your shoulders and hips stacked.
Contract the side of your core to raise your hips back to the starting position, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your supporting elbow directly below your shoulder.
Lower your hips without allowing them to rotate forward or backward.
Raise your hips until your body forms a straight line without overextending.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you raise them.
results.description: Dumbbell Side Plank Up Down is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Glutes, Forearms.

results.name: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended vertically and your feet together. Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest and extend your arms toward your legs.
Engage your core and lift your head, shoulders, and upper back while reaching the dumbbell toward your feet.
Pause briefly at the top and contract your abdominal muscles while keeping your legs raised and still.
Slowly lower your upper back toward the floor while maintaining the vertical leg position, then repeat.
tips: Keep your arms extended and the dumbbell securely held with both hands.
Keep your lower back controlled against the floor as you lower your torso.
Avoid swinging your arms or using momentum to complete the crunch.
Exhale as you crunch upward and inhale as you lower your upper body.
results.description: Dumbbell Suitcase Crunch is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques, Shoulders.

results.name: Flat Knee Raise
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Place your hands lightly behind your head, and rest your head and shoulders against the floor.
Engage your core and lift both feet together, drawing your knees toward your chest while maintaining the bend in your legs.
Continue raising your knees until they are positioned above your abdomen, gently tilting your pelvis toward your ribs without lifting your upper back.
Slowly lower both legs until your feet return to the floor, maintaining control throughout the descent, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Support your head lightly without pulling on your neck with your hands.
Draw both knees upward together without swinging or using momentum.
Lower your feet slowly and touch the floor lightly before beginning the next repetition.
Exhale as you draw your knees toward your chest and inhale as you lower your feet.
results.description: Flat Knee Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Flutter Kicks
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your arms at your sides, palms facing down. Place your hands under your hips for added support if needed.
Lift your legs off the floor a few inches, keeping them straight and close together.
Quickly alternate kicking your legs up and down in a small, controlled motion, engaging your core throughout the movement.
Continue the flutter kicks for the desired duration, maintaining a steady and controlled pace. Lower your legs back to the floor to complete the exercise.
tips: Move your legs in a controlled manner to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you kick your legs and inhaling as you maintain the movement.
Avoid letting your lower back arch off the floor; keep it pressed down to prevent strain.
Adjust the height of your kicks to suit your fitness level and comfort, starting with smaller kicks and increasing the range of motion as you build strength.
results.description: Flutter Kicks is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors.

results.name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, your arms straight, and your legs together.
Engage your core and raise both straight legs forward.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the floor.
Lower your legs with control to the hanging position, then repeat.
tips: Raise your legs without swinging your body.
Lower your legs slowly instead of letting them drop.
Keep your neck relaxed and look straight ahead.
Exhale as you raise your legs and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Hanging Leg Raises is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps, Middle Back.
